visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with glasses wearing a vibrant floral shirt stands in a brightly lit aisle of a supermarket. She speaks directly to the camera, gesturing towards the tall shelves behind her which are densely packed with various skincare and makeup remover bottles of different colors and brands like Nivea and Garnier. (2) A brief cutaway shows a younger woman in a clean bathroom setting, looking into a mirror and carefully applying black mascara to her eyelashes with a wand; she wears a light green plush headband to keep her hair back. The lighting is soft and natural, emphasizing the detailed makeup application process. (3) The scene returns to the primary speaker in the supermarket, who continues her professional explanation with active hand gestures. She occasionally points at specific blue and pink bottles on the shelves to illustrate her points about oil-based versus water-based products in a retail environment. (4) She demonstrates the moisturizing effect of the oil by rubbing her own forearm with her hand, smiling warmly while she explains the beneficial skin-softening properties of coconut oil. The camera remains at an eye-level medium shot, focusing on her upper body and gestures. (5) The video concludes with a static graphic screen on a white and gray background displaying the dermatology clinic's logo, phone numbers, social media handles, and physical addresses in Taiwan. The text is neatly organized and clearly legible for the viewers to contact the clinic.

The background music remains steady in volume, providing a continuous melodic layer that complements the speaker's vocal clarity during the explanation. (3) The vocal delivery continues with a moderate speed and clear articulation of every syllable, while a subtle 'ding' SFX is heard when a new instructional text point appears on screen. The acoustic guitar BGM continues to provide an upbeat, major-key atmosphere that enhances the professional educational vibe of the segment.
